caption: The drawing depicts a pair of light tan or beige striped trousers, rendered in pencil and colored detail in the center of the page. The trousers are depicted from the front, showing details such as the waistband, fly, and buttons at the front waist closure and along the fly. The vertical pinstripes are evenly spaced and faint. There is a small notch at the bottom outer edge of each pant leg. To the upper right of the main drawing, there is a less detailed outline sketch of the trousers, showing the rear view that includes a faint indication of the seat and waistband but with minimal detail or shading. The drawing is placed on a plain, light-colored background.
title: Pantaloons
